name: Photo Develop
description: The first clip washes out to a blank card, then the second develops on it like an instant photo. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: wash
params.description: How long the first clip takes to wash out

params.name: tint
params.description: Strength of the cast while the picture develops
